messages:
alex: FYI customers reported transient invoice-preview spikes after we flipped the priority router. looks like meter sometimes emits before tenant enrichment completes.
priya: can you share a short trace?
alex: snippet (redacted):
```
2026-05-02T11:20:00.001Z INFO req=R1 router=priority-fast decision=optimistic
2026-05-02T11:20:00.002Z DEBUG enrich=start req=R1
2026-05-02T11:20:00.003Z INFO router=fallback stable-route req=R1
2026-05-02T11:20:00.004Z INFO meter=emit tenant=null tokens=12 req=R1
2026-05-02T11:20:00.006Z INFO enrich=done tenant=org-7 req=R1
2026-05-02T11:20:00.007Z INFO billing-ingest tenant=org-7 req=R1
```
alex: So preview shows spike on fallback until reconciler attaches org-7.
dan: blocking until enrichment hurts p50 for fast lane. we should instead emit provisional events and reconcile.
priya: Agreed. Plan: add attribution_key (sha256(reqid+session)), provisional:true flag, and original_route in billing events. reconciler will emit correction events with final=true.
dan: Preview service needs to fold corrections quickly and UI should show a small "draft" badge for provisional lines. also add metrics: provisional_emits, corrections_applied, late_enrichment_ms.
ops-bot: ALERT: invoice-preview-anomaly triggered 4x in last 30m in eu-west.
priya: rollout: feature-flag provisional emits at router, shadow 1% for 48h, then 5% if diffs <0.05%. rollback threshold: tenant-level diffs >0.1% or >2 support tickets/day. ticket INF-8001 opened.
alex: owners: infra=priya, billing+reconciler=dan, preview-ui=alex. will draft customer blurb and support playbook. thanks :thumbsup:
